T01_a1.label: Clasp
T01_a1.line: The pavé bar is about 45% too long for the ring and is not joined to the chain.

T01_a2.label: Clasp
T01_a2.line: A lumpy extra clip, like a melted lobster clasp, sits where the chain meets the ring.

T01_a3.label: Clasp
T01_a3.line: The bar is a loose piece with both chain ends on the ring, and the necklace reads about 30 cm, not 50.

T02_a1.label: Clasp
T02_a1.line: The pavé bar dangles below the ring like a drop, about 50% too long, with an extra hook.

T02_a2.label: Clasp
T02_a2.line: The bar is not hung from its end, so it looks centre-hung like a plain T-bar, and the chain is half length.

T02_a3.label: Clasp
T02_a3.line: The pavé bar is longer than the ring and joined to nothing, so the toggle could not close.

T03_a1.label: Clasp
T03_a1.line: The chain hooks straight onto the bottom of the ring instead of a jump ring beside the gate.

T03_e1.label: Fix not made
T03_e1.line: The edit missed the fix: the chain still hooks the ring's bottom, and the bar is now loose.

T03_e2.label: Fix not made
T03_e2.line: The fix was missed again: the chain still hooks the ring's bottom, and a stray ring was added.

T04_a1.label: Scale
T04_a1.line: Drawn about 70% too big against the door studs, with only 21 links, so it reads like a bracelet.

T04_a2.label: Scale
T04_a2.line: The clasp is about 38% too big for the door studs and reads chunky on the fine chain.

T05_a1.label: Two necklaces
T05_a1.line: The chain wraps the vase twice and reads as two layered necklaces, not one 50 cm strand.

T05_a2.label: Scale
T05_a2.line: The chain is only about 25 cm, so it reads as a choker, not the 50 cm necklace.

T05_a3.label: Clasp
T05_a3.line: The bar became a long loose T-bar, and the chain reads as a choker plus a second dangling strand.

T06_a1.label: Clasp
T06_a1.line: The pavé bar is a loose piece joined to nothing, so this toggle could not close the necklace.

T06_e1.label: Fix not made
T06_e1.line: The clasp fix was not made: the bar still lies loose, and the ring reads about 50% too big.

T07_a1.label: Face in frame
T07_a1.line: A chin and jaw crept into the top-left corner of the frame.

T07_a1c.label: Note
T07_a1c.line: The hand-at-the-clasp gesture reads in a second and puts the eye straight on the toggle.

T08_a1.label: Scale
T08_a1.line: The ring reads about 27 mm, nearly twice its real 15 mm, and a chin shows at the top.

T08_a2.label: Clasp
T08_a2.line: The bar became a long T-bar across the whole ring, and a chin, jaw and ear show at the top.

T09_a1.label: Face in frame
T09_a1.line: Lips, chin, jaw and an ear fill the top of the frame meant for the headline.

T09_a2.label: Face in frame
T09_a2.line: A chin and the underside of the jaw show at the top of the frame.

T10_a1.label: Note
T10_a1.line: Diwali gifting reads in a second, with warm diya glow and crisp highlights on the ring.

W01_a1.label: Note
W01_a1.line: The hoop-in-a-hoop pun reads in a second, with warm light picking out every ridge of the braid.

W02_a1.label: Note
W02_a1.line: It is the most graphic, literal hoop-in-a-hoop, with excellent braid detail and crisp highlights.

W03_a1.label: Off-palette
W03_a1.line: The oatmeal linen reads beige, off the blush palette, and fills over half the frame.

W03_a2.label: Note
W03_a2.line: The hoop-on-a-spool pun reads in a second, on blush linen with a calm wall for the headline.

W04_a1.label: Scale
W04_a1.line: The charpai rope is drawn far too thin, so the hoops read about 6 cm across, not 25 mm.

W04_a2.label: Scale
W04_a2.line: The rope is still bundles of thin cords, so the hoops read about 5 to 7 cm, not 25 mm.

W04_a3.label: Note
W04_a3.line: There is no calm copy space, as the whole frame is a high-contrast lattice with dark gaps.

W05_a1.label: Off-palette
W05_a1.line: The frame is a golden beige and tan field, and the gold hoops sink into it.

W05_a2.label: Note
W05_a2.line: The hanging-in-the-loom idea reads in a second; the hoops are large, crisp and faithful.

W06_a1.label: Face in frame
W06_a1.line: An eyebrow, eyelashes, cheek and jawline show on the right side of the frame.

W06_a3.label: Note
W06_a3.line: The two-braids pun reads in under a second: one hair braid flanked by two braided gold hoops.

W07_a1.label: Note
W07_a1.line: The floss grades apricot and oatmeal rather than blush, and the one visible disc reads dull caramel.

W07_a2.label: Note
W07_a2.line: The strongest plate of its round: texture on texture lands instantly and the gold is the brightest thing.

W08_a2.label: Scale
W08_a2.line: Against the cane the hoops read as 4 to 5 cm statement hoops, and the honey-tan cane is off palette.

W08_a3.label: Scale
W08_a3.line: The hoops still read as 4 cm statement hoops against the cane, and the cane is straw, not ivory.

W09_a1.label: Face in frame
W09_a1.line: The jawline and a broad cheek show in front of the ear.

W09_a3.label: Face in frame
W09_a3.line: The jawline, a bare cheek and the outline of a nose tip through the hair are all in frame.

W10_a1.label: Note
W10_a1.line: The gift-box styling is generic, Diwali does not read without copy, and the hoops look chunky.

W10_a2.label: Note
W10_a2.line: Runs as a Diwali gifting ad: warm, on palette, with crisp, faithful gold and clean copy space.

H01_a1.label: Note
H01_a1.line: A printed ECG trace under the strand makes two heartbeat lines and muddies the joke.

H01_e1.label: Note
H01_e1.line: The bracelet is now the only heartbeat line, ending in the gold heart: the camp's strongest idea.

H02_a1.label: Scale
H02_a1.line: Drawn about 30% too small for the ECG grid, with the heart about 44% too small.

H02_a2.label: Scale
H02_a2.line: Drawn about 35 to 40% too small for the ECG grid, and 3 beads short at 20, not 23.

H03_a1.label: Construction
H03_a1.line: Reads as a double-strand bracelet with loose wire ends, and the beads are about 45% too big.

H03_a2.label: Construction
H03_a2.line: It has two T-bars, only 14 beads instead of 23, and gaps between the beads like a ball chain.

H04_a1.label: Note
H04_a1.line: Reads as a bracelet on a drum rather than a beat, and the drum head outshines the piece.

H04_a2.label: Note
H04_a2.line: The bright drum skin outshines the grey beads, and the beat idea still needs the copy to land.

H05_a1.label: Scale
H05_a1.line: The beads read about 40 to 48% too big against the wrist and nails, so the bracelet looks chunky.

H05_a2.label: Note
H05_a2.line: The Kathak idea does not read, since we see the back of a spread hand, and the bracelet is small.

H06_a1.label: Scale
H06_a1.line: The beads read about 40% too big against her nails, and a chin shows at the top edge.

H06_a2.label: Scale
H06_a2.line: Beside her fingers the beads read about 1 cm, nearly 60% too big, and a chin shows at the top.

H07_a1.label: Note
H07_a1.line: The palm and fingers fill the top third meant for the headline, and the beads read dark.

H07_a2.label: Off-palette
H07_a2.line: A dark brown wall shows in the top-left corner, right where the headline should sit.

H08_a1.label: Note
H08_a1.line: The gold heart is the brightest, sharpest thing in frame; gold against silver reads instantly.

H09_a1.label: Note
H09_a1.line: The silver-varq pun reads in a second, and the starburst of kaju katli feels festive.

H10_a1.label: Off-palette
H10_a1.line: The handmade paper and curtain read beige and sand, off the blush palette.

H10_a2.label: Note
H10_a2.line: The bracelet lies on the envelopes instead of tying them like a ribbon, so the wit is lost.

P01_a1.label: Note
P01_a1.line: The colour-in-a-straight-line idea reads in a second, and the frame is graphic and on palette.

P02_a1.label: Stone count
P02_a1.line: The whole bracelet shows only 14 stones, not 20, so it reads about 13 cm long.

P02_a2.label: Stone count
P02_a2.line: Both clasp ends show again with only 13 stones, not 20; a crop hiding the ends could rescue it.

P02_a2c.label: Note
P02_a2c.line: With the clasp ends cropped out, the colour-in-a-line idea reads in a second; the pavé is the sharpest thing.

P03_a1.label: Note
P03_a1.line: The pastel seeds camouflage the matching stones, and the headline area goes a dusky brown peach.

P03_a2.label: Clasp
P03_a2.line: The free end stops at a bare stone with no clasp, so the bracelet reads as having none.

P04_a1.label: Scale
P04_a1.line: The stones read about 50% too big for the loop, which holds about 13 stones, not 20, on a tan wall.

P04_a2.label: Scale
P04_a2.line: The stones read about 40% too big for the loop, which holds about 12 stones, not 20, with grey halos.

P05_a1.label: Stone order
P05_a1.line: Two pink stones sit side by side, and the whole bracelet has only 9 stones, each as wide as a pencil.

P05_a2.label: Scale
P05_a2.line: Each stone spans about two pencils, not one, so the stones read about 75% too big.

P06_a1.label: Stone count
P06_a1.line: The whole bracelet shows only 12 stones, not 20, so each one reads about 60% too big.

P06_a2.label: Scale
P06_a2.line: Against the 6 cm prism the stones read about 60% too big; the prism looks under 4 cm tall.

P07_a1.label: Scale
P07_a1.line: Each stone is over 80% of a fingernail wide instead of half, so the bracelet reads chunky.

P07_a2.label: Scale
P07_a2.line: Each stone is wider than her fingernail, more than twice its real size.

P08_a1.label: Scale
P08_a1.line: The stones read about 50% too big against her fingernails and wrist.

P08_a2.label: Note
P08_a2.line: The bracelet is small in the tall frame, and halos twice the real width shrink the colour.

P09_a1.label: Note
P09_a1.line: It has the best product fidelity of the set, with a catchlight in every front stone.

P10_a1.label: Stone count
P10_a1.line: The whole bracelet shows only 11 stones, not 20, and neither clasp end has its fold-over latch.

P10_a2.label: Stone order
P10_a2.line: Two aqua stones sit side by side, and against the brush the stones read nearly twice their size.

aqua1_a1.label: Construction
aqua1_a1.line: The C hoop is bent into a wide hook with an invented stem, and the stones read as all baguettes.

aquaB1_a1.label: Scale
aquaB1_a1.line: Against the lemonade glass the earring reads about 56 mm long, twice its real 27 mm.

bow1_a1.label: Scale
bow1_a1.line: On the 5 cm gift box the bow reads about 20 mm, about 43% over its real 14 mm.

bowB1_a1.label: Scale
bowB1_a1.line: On the strawberry the bow reads about 22 mm, about 57% over its real 14 mm, like a brooch.

cluster1_a1.label: Pearl count
cluster1_a1.line: It carries 8 seed pearls, copying the macro shot, where the brief and three listing photos show 6.

clusterB1_a1.label: Stone order
clusterB1_a1.line: The last two stones are swapped into a mirror arc, and the stud reads about 45% too big.

clusterC1_lite.label: Scale
clusterC1_lite.line: Against the 2 cm jelly sweets the stud reads about 34 mm, about 70% over its real 20 mm.

dome1_a1.label: Note
dome1_a1.line: The not-a-mint idea reads in a second; the gold is the only shine, so the eye goes straight to it.

domeB1_a1.label: Scale
domeB1_a1.line: On the espresso cup the huggie reads about 27 mm, twice its real 14 mm, like an ordinary handle.

halo1_a1.label: Note
halo1_a1.line: The bell plate reads as a trinket dish, so the doorbell idea lands late, and the earring is small.

haloB1_a1.label: Scale
haloB1_a1.line: Against the shuttlecock the disc reads about 20 mm, not 14 mm, and the earring seems to hover.

papillon1_a1.label: Scale
papillon1_a1.line: In the specimen box the butterfly reads about 30 mm across, not 18 mm, about 70% too big.

papillonB1_a1.label: Scale
papillonB1_a1.line: Against the coupe the butterfly reads about 25 mm, not 18 mm, and its wings are drawn folded.

quatrefoil1_a1.label: Scale
quatrefoil1_a1.line: Against the jaali cut-outs the stud reads about 25 to 35 mm, not its real 15 mm.

quatrefoil1_a1c.label: Note
quatrefoil1_a1c.line: Hard low sun and a bright gold glint; the stud is the sharpest thing in its pool of light.

riviere1_a1.label: Wrong stones
riviere1_a1.line: Baguette-like step-cut blocks replace the round brilliants, and the huggie reads about 40 mm, not 15 mm.

riviereB1_a1.label: Scale
riviereB1_a1.line: Drawn about 45% too big next to the sugar crystals, so it reads as a mid-size hoop.

square1_a1.label: Scale
square1_a1.line: Against the barfi the huggie reads about 23 mm, about 55% over its real 15 mm.

squareB1_a1.label: Note
squareB1_a1.line: One gold square where an ice cube should be reads in under a second; the gold is the brightest thing.

torsade1_a1.label: Scale
torsade1_a1.line: Next to the croissants the huggies read about 23 to 25 mm, not 18 mm, like mid-size hoops.

torsadeB1_a1.label: Scale
torsadeB1_a1.line: Drawn half a croissant long, about 26 mm, not 18 mm, and the croissants do not read as minis.

verdant1_a1.label: Note
verdant1_a1.line: The two-peas-in-a-pod idea reads in a second, and the studs are the sharpest sparkle in frame.

verdantB1_a1.label: Scale
verdantB1_a1.line: Against the pink cricket ball each stud reads about 21 mm, about 73% over its real 12 mm.
